name: Shenzhen Ruiyan Intelligent Control Co.,Ltd.
name_zh: 深圳市睿研智能控制有限公司
summary:
Shenzhen Ruiyan Intelligent Control Co., Ltd. was established in September 2021, with Tian Bo as chairman. The company focuses on research, development and production of core robotics components. Its main products include robot joint modules, dexterous hands, encoders and drives. The RY-H1 series dexterous hand uses 16 degrees of freedom and 21 motion joints to reproduce complex movements precisely, with linear actuation and intelligent hybrid force-position control algorithms for safe grasping. The company develops its technology in-house across the full stack. Its products have undergone repeated iterations and testing and are used in service robots, education and research, and specialized operations.

In 2025, the company received national High and New Technology Enterprise and Technology-Based Small and Medium-Sized Enterprise recognition and was included in a ranking of the core competitiveness of Chinese end-effector companies. Through full-stack in-house development and continuous refinement of intelligent control algorithms, it has established technical strengths in service robots, education and research, and specialized operations.
